character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Pixel art character sprite of a golden Armor/Mega-level dragon knight warrior inspired by Magnamon, dynamic aerial battle pose, three-quarter front view.

Visual Design:
- Body & Anatomy: Athletic azure-blue draconic humanoid frame with white chest/belly plate, large clawed blue hands with curved silver talons, and a pointed blue reptilian tail.
- Golden Armor Plating: Highly reflective, angular polished gold Chrome Digizoid armor plates; heavy angular chestplate, wide skirt tassets with sharp dagger-like hip guards, massive faceted golden greaves with mechanical four-toed armored boots, and heavy forearm bracers.
- Head & Visor: Faceted golden dragon helm with sharp multi-pointed crown crests framing the face, revealing sharp red dragon eyes.
- Shoulder Thrusters: Heavy angular golden shoulder pods angled backward, featuring internal black missile launchers / energy vent ports.

Style Specifications:
- 32-bit crisp RPG pixel art sprite, 64x64 or 128x128 canvas.
- Bright luminous gold highlights, high-contrast cybernetic reflections, clean dark outlines.
- Full-body character sprite centered, isolated on a clean transparent background.
